basin_state.coupled_use: sole accepted surface-water state for represented store

level_demand.semantics: minimum and maximum level are independently optional; allocation targets end-of-allocation-step level/storage range

allocation_controlled_supply.coupled_use: realize WSCAP-like supply capacity and scarcity in Ribasim

tabulated_rating_curve.interpolation: PCHIP between supplied points; Q=0 below lowest supplied level; extrapolation behavior above maximum follows product rule
tabulated_rating_curve.allocation_controlled: allocation chooses flow within predicted physical Q(h) capacity; physical layer applies min(allocated,Q(h)) plus reduction factors
tabulated_rating_curve.q1a_warning: Native TabulatedRatingCurve exact equivalence to the hard-kink linear SWQHR1 law is falsified for the pinned release. V1 three-point and R2 two-point inputs both inherit PCHIP smoothing because Ribasim internally augments the knot set. Use native TRC only under an explicit approximation envelope or for source tables whose PCHIP representation is independently acceptable.

basin_vertical_forcings.coupled_use: mass-transfer endpoints, not replacements for SWAP constitutive exchange physics

explicit_controlled_discharge.semantics: Source-derived control maps Basin level to the intended nonnegative discharge law; Pump realizes one-way physical flow.
explicit_controlled_discharge.q1a_result: Q1A-R3 trajectory and Q1A-R3L direct-ledger PASS for the frozen BETAW=1 fixed-weir cases.
explicit_controlled_discharge.limitation: Research-qualified mapping only; no production admission and no generic nonlinear SWQHR1 claim.

basin_storage_profile.pinned_source_semantics: Basin/Profile accepts `storage` with `level`; if area is absent, Ribasim differentiates storage by a recurrence, linearly interpolates dS/dh, and integrates/inverts that area curve.
basin_storage_profile.exact_input_knot_storage: By construction storage increments at supplied profile knots are reproduced, apart from the separate bottom-origin convention.
basin_storage_profile.inter_knot_semantics: Generally not the same as SWAP STTAB piecewise-linear storage interpolation; the integrated linear area curve is quadratic within an interval whenever endpoint dS/dh differs.
basin_storage_profile.bottom_storage: Ribasim physical storage origin is zero at the profile bottom; frozen SWAP may have a sub-ULP positive bottom STTAB value from knot construction.
basin_storage_profile.qualification: Q1G preregistered; exact direct STTAB mapping not assumed.

hard_mapping_rules: Do not identify a Ribasim parameter name with SWAP process ownership merely because the names match.
Do not represent the same physical surface-water storage in SWAP and Ribasim.
Do not encode a signed SWAP exchange as a single unsigned Ribasim forcing without preserving direction.
Do not assume TabulatedRatingCurve interpolation is piecewise linear.
Do not use allocation output as accepted physical mass before the coupled physical transaction accepts.
Do not treat a two-point TabulatedRatingCurve as piecewise-linear exactness in the pinned release; internal knot augmentation plus PCHIP changes the above-crest curve.
Do not equate a Ribasim Basin storage-profile input with exact SWAP STTAB piecewise-linear interpolation between knots until Q1G is closed.
